results.name: J-Packaging & Display
results.notes: Operating: live site, and a Loc8NearMe listing at 25 Kimberly Rd, East Brunswick with Mon-Fri 7:30-3:30 hours and six reviews (all full star), consistent with the recorded 5.0/6. Server HTML for index.html, services.html and contacts.html contains no <title> element at all (head goes straight from the script block to </head>), no meta description, no viewport meta, generator 'Web Page Maker V2', a fixed 791px #container, zero forms, zero tel: links, zero H1 and no JSON-LD. At 390px the whole desktop page is scaled down and the text is unreadable, as recorded. Contacts page shows Phone (732) 390-8112, Fax (732) 390-8118, mailto:jferreira@j-packaging.com, and the nav 'Customer Access' item points at http://j-packaging.merganser.us/customeraccess. Services page does state orders arrive 'via web, e-mail, phone, fax and mail'. robots.txt is one sitemap line only. Scores as given are reasonable. Caveat: the shared browser rewrites document.title with a '🐴 ' prefix, which can make an absent title look present - titles were checked against the raw server HTML instead.

results.name: Alpha Omega Amusements Sales
results.notes: Operating, but with no live primary site: https://www.alphaomegasales.com/, https://alphaomegasales.com/ and http://alphaomegasales.com/ all return 404, and the browser lands on Wix's 'This domain isn't connected to a site' page. Google Maps for 12 Elkins Rd shows 'Alpha Omega Amusements & Sales', 3.3, category Manufacturer, phone (732) 254-3773, and its Website button resolves to http://alphaomegasales.com/ - so the dead-domain claim holds. A second listing, Alpha-Bet Entertainment, LLC, sits at the same address with (800) 253-4045, no reviews, and its site http://www.alpha-bet.net/ now also returns 404. redemptionreport.com is live with 2025 content, names Alpha-Omega at 12 Elkins Road with 732-254-3773, and carries a banner linking to http://alphaomegasales.com. IAAPA's marketplace profile corroborates the arcade sales/parts/service description. Minor caveat: the 800 hotline is shown on the Alpha-Bet listing rather than an Alpha-Omega page. Scores as given are reasonable.

results.name: Samy CPA, LLC

wrong_claims.claim: Page title is literally 'Home' and the meta description is 'Home' on every page; service pages inherit the same generic title
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Only the home page is titled 'Home'. /contact-us/ is titled 'Contact us' and /business-services/ 'Business Services' (same text in the meta description). Titles are still generic and never name accounting, tax or North Brunswick, but they are not all 'Home'.

https://samycpa.com/robots.txt returns the site's HTML shell with HTTP 200 (a soft 404, title 'SamyCPA'), so no robots directives are served, but the response is not a 404. Practical effect for crawlers is the same as recorded.

results.notes: Everything else checks out. Google Maps: 'Samy CPA, LLC', 1.0, Accounting firm, 622 Georges Rd Ste 203, (609) 947-2447, with 'Claim this business', 'Add hours' and 'Add photos & videos' prompts and no review count shown - the unclaimed/1.0/no-hours claim is accurate. Site: viewport meta present, one contact form on /contact-us/ (name, email, phone, company, message, no CAPTCHA), zero JSON-LD, zero tel: links, mailto:samycpa@gmail.com. Gap lowered from 5 to 4 because the site is HTTPS, mobile-capable and has a working form - the gap is local search, schema, titles and credibility rather than a broken site. Evidence lowered from 4 to 3 because two checkable details were wrong.

Henry Companies LLC.'; one Wix contact form, no scheduling. robots.txt is the Wix default (Allow: /, PetalBot blocked). results.name: Staffing Front Inc.

wrong_claims.claim: No contact or requirement form - clients and candidates must email or call; 'no form exists on the site'; nothing is bookable
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The site runs two Contact Form 7 forms. /contact/ has a client enquiry form (name, email, phone, company, subject, message, submit) and /careers/upload-resume/ has a candidate form with a required file upload (.pdf/.doc/.docx etc.) plus name, email, phone and company. There is still no requirement-spec field, no scheduler and no confirmation/tracking flow, but forms do exist.

wrong_claims.claim: robots.txt could not be fetched (same TLS error), so crawler rules are unknown
wrong_claims.what_is_true: http://www.staffingfront.com/robots.txt serves the standard WordPress robots.txt: 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/ / Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php'. Crawler rules are known and permissive.

wrong_claims.claim: Contact page lists three phones and five mailboxes and nothing else
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The contact page lists two numbers - 848 202 1530 and +1 732 909 2005 (the latter labelled as a fax icon in the sidebar and footer) - plus five mailboxes (hr@, accounting@, legal@, info@, jobs@), and a contact form.

results.notes: The core issue still stands: https://www.staffingfront.com/ fails in Chrome with net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID and only http:// works; imagery is all /2018/03/, the careers page still says 'email resumes with salary requirements to jobs@', the 'Horizontals' and 'Verticals' menus are swapped, there is mojibake in the copy, the footer reads '2018 ©', and template breadcrumbs point at a dev host (web.goigi.me/staffingfrontwp). Gap lowered from 5 to 4 and evidence from 4 to 2 because two of the four top issues (no forms, unknown robots) were wrong. agent_readiness 'bookable 0' remains right for scheduling, but the estate is not formless.

results.name: Strategy Staff (Strategic Staffing Solutions)
results.notes: Verified: title is just 'Strategy Staff', meta description is the tagline 'Connecting the Right People to the Right Jobs'; the only JSON-LD is a WebSite block; two forms on the page; zero tel: links; the header renders a bare 'Select Page' WordPress dropdown instead of a logo at 390px with no call or quote CTA; https://strategystaff.com/contact/ returns a real '404 - Page not found - Strategy Staff' page; robots.txt allows Googlebot, bingbot and '*' and blocks only /wp-admin/. Copy confirms '35 NJ DOT compliant employee shuttle vehicles', seven named recruiting centres (Sparta, Clifton/Passaic, North Brunswick, Lake Hopatcong, Bound Brook, Union City, Freehold), 'over twenty' years and '© 2000-2026'. Google Maps: claimed profile (no 'Claim this business'), 4.2, Employment agency, 1086 Livingston Ave, (732) 247-4773, photos present. Gap lowered from 5 to 4: with a claimed 4.2 profile with photos, HTTPS, correct NAP and two working forms the estate is better than the other gap-5 records; the real deficits are the one-page structure, titles/schema and no click-to-call. Could not expand the panel hours to confirm the stated 6 AM opening.

results.name: Salem Engineering

wrong_claims.claim: Contact page lists only the Vermont PO Box and physical address - no street address for the North Brunswick office, no form, no email
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The Contact view does list only PO Box 70 and 114 Sunset Road, Charlotte VT, with no NJ street address and no form - that part holds. But the site does publish email addresses: the Our Team view carries mailto:tom@salemengineering.com (Thomas P. Reilly, P.E.) and mailto:ibrahima@salemengineering.com (Ibrahima Ndour, P.E.), so 'no email' overstates it.

results.notes: Everything else holds: title 'Salem Engineering' with a good meta description naming both offices; no viewport meta; zero JSON-LD; zero forms; zero tel: links; footer '© Salem Engineering 2014+'; nav items are href="#" with JS handlers and project/licence detail sits behind PDFs and an amCharts map; the header carries only 'NORTH BRUNSWICK, NJ 08902 (732)997-7209' and 'CHARLOTTE, VT 05445 (802)310-6525'. robots.txt disallows a long legacy path list but does not block crawlers. Google Maps for the name in North Brunswick returns only 'Salem Engineering, Inc.', Mechanical engineer, 114 Sunset Rd, Charlotte VT - no rating, 'Add missing information', 'Add a photo'. Scores left as recorded.

data_gaps: The shared browser prepends '🐴 ' to document.title (observed on every page loaded), so titles read through the browser DOM can look non-empty on pages that have no title at all. Titles were re-checked against raw server HTML or the page's own <title> element.

Google Maps displayed only a limited view: closing times were visible but hours panels could not be expanded, so the recorded 'opens 8 AM' (C. Henry) and '6 AM opening' (Strategy Staff) could not be confirmed, and review counts were not shown for most profiles.

Alpha-Omega's toll-free 800-253-4045 appears on the separate Alpha-Bet Entertainment, LLC listing at the same address, not on an Alpha-Omega page; the recorded 'separate toll-free customer hotline' is therefore an inference from a related listing.

Navigation to http://www.staffingfront.com/ in the shared browser was blocked by the client (net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT); the https certificate failure was confirmed directly (net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID) and page content was read over http via HTTP fetch.
Form behaviour after submit (spam handling, confirmation emails, tracking of resume uploads) was not tested - no form was submitted anywhere, per read-only rules.

Google Business Profile fields that require the owner view (claimed/unclaimed status was inferred only from the presence or absence of the 'Claim this business' prompt) could not be inspected directly.
